claims.text: Do (●): length/height and weight; head circumference; weight-for-length; hearing; developmental surveillance; behavioral/social/emotional screen; newborn blood screen; newborn bilirubin; critical congenital heart defect.
claims.locator: Periodicity Schedule p. 1 chart, column "Newborn": ● in rows Length/Height and Weight, Head Circumference, Weight for Length, Hearing, Developmental Surveillance, Behavioral/Social/Emotional Screening, Newborn Blood, Newborn Bilirubin, Critical Congenital Heart Defect; chart key

claims.text: Risk assessment (★), act if positive: blood pressure; vision; hepatitis B.
claims.quote: = risk assessment to be performed with appropriate action to follow, if positive
claims.locator: Periodicity Schedule p. 1 chart, column "Newborn": ★ in rows Blood Pressure, Vision, Hepatitis B Virus Infection; chart key

claims.text: After birth: evaluate the newborn; encourage breastfeeding and offer instruction and support.
claims.quote: Newborns should have an evaluation after birth, and breastfeeding should be encouraged (and instruction and support should be offered).

claims.text: Hearing: confirm the initial screen was completed, verify results, and follow up as appropriate.
claims.quote: Confirm initial screen was completed, verify results, and follow up, as appropriate.

claims.text: Newborn blood screen: confirm the initial screen was done, verify results, and follow up; the Recommended Uniform Screening Panel and state laws set what is screened.
claims.quote: Confirm initial screen was accomplished, verify results, and follow up, as appropriate. The Recommended Uniform Screening Panel (https://www.hrsa.gov/ advisory-committees/heritable-disorders/rusp/index.html), as determined by The Secretary’s Advisory Committee on Heritable Disorders in Newborns and Children, and state newborn screening laws/regulations (https://www.babysfirsttest.org/) establish the criteria for and coverage of newborn screening procedures and programs.

claims.text: Bilirubin: confirm initial screening was done, verify results, and follow up, per the AAP hyperbilirubinemia guideline.
claims.quote: Confirm initial screening was accomplished, verify results, and follow up, as appropriate. See “Clinical Practice Guideline Revision: Management of Hyperbilirubinemia in the Newborn Infant 35 or More Weeks of Gestation”

claims.text: Critical congenital heart disease: pulse oximetry after 24 hours of age, before discharge.
claims.quote: Screening for critical congenital heart disease using pulse oximetry should be performed in newborns, after 24 hours of age, before discharge from the hospital

claims.text: Hepatitis B: risk assessment per the USPSTF and the AAP Red Book, preserving confidentiality.
claims.quote: Perform a risk assessment for hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection according to recommendations per the USPSTF (https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/ uspstf/recommendation/hepatitis-b-virus-infection-screening) and in the 2021–2024 edition of the AAP Red Book: Report of the Committee on Infectious Diseases, making every effort to preserve confidentiality of the patient.

claims.text: Blood pressure: measure in infants and children with specific risk conditions at visits before age 3 years.
claims.quote: Blood pressure measurement in infants and children with specific risk conditions should be performed at visits before age 3 years.

claims.text: Immunizations: every visit is an opportunity to update and complete them.
claims.quote: Every visit should be an opportunity to update and complete a child’s immunizations.
